crossRefs.note: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason…

translations.web: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.
translations.bsb: The slacker is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer discreetly.
translations.kjv: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
translations.asv: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit Than seven men that can render a reason.
